title: check: revocation on a branch dropped by merge -s ours is ignored
description:
A revocation committed on a branch that a merge then drops (`merge -s ours`, or a conflict resolution that deletes the file) is ignored. It does not appear in the revocation file, and nothing is warned.

Where (HEAD 4237c43): registry_history at git-vouch:1233-1238 collects the paths to read from `git log --name-only -- people tiers revocations anchors.json` without --full-history. Default history simplification follows only the TREESAME parent of such a merge, so the side branch's paths are never listed. The second log at 1241-1268 does see the merge's diff against the dropped side (kept[rel]), but kept is only consulted for names already in `names` (1272), so it does not help. file_history (full history) is never called for the path.

Reproduced (scratchpad a1/revmerge.sh):
- Control: on a branch, linus revokes alice's key, and a later plain commit deletes the file. check says "is revoked but not retired", and the revocation file has 1 line. This matches DESIGN.md: once committed, a revocation holds even if deleted.
- Same revocation commit, but main merges the branch with `git merge -s ours`. The revoke commit is an ancestor of HEAD, yet check prints only "alice contributor" with no revocation warning, the revocation file has 0 lines, and alice's key is exported.

(A revocation added only inside a merge commit and deleted later is caught, because the deleting commit lists the path.)

This breaks DESIGN.md Revocation, "Revocations are read from history, so once committed one holds even if its file is later deleted". An auditor who sees the revoke commit in `git log` will believe the key is revoked. A merger can withhold a revocation anyway, but here the history shows it as merged.

Fix: add --full-history to the --name-only log at 1234, or add every rel in `kept` to `names` before the loop at 1272. Add the -s ours case to tests/test_check_history.py.
notes: Done (uncommitted): --full-history on the --name-only log in registry_history. Test test_revocation_dropped_by_merge_ours_still_holds, mutation-checked. Remaining: full-suite run did not finish before handoff; commit pending; DESIGN.md Revocation sentence (docs unit).
close_reason: registry_history lists paths with --full-history, so a revocation on a branch dropped by merge -s ours still holds; test test_revocation_dropped_by_merge_ours_still_holds
